limitations: Missing district-months are absent observations, not zero: a zero would claim the month was surveyed.
Every view stops at the last complete month: the current month is left out while its landings come in.
Figures resting on fewer than 10 landings are thin and can swing widely from one month to the next.
Recorded figures describe the surveyed landings, not the whole fleet.
Estimated figures exist only for district-months with at least 10 surveyed trips, and leave out fishing without boats, such as gleaning on foot.
Values are as reported at the landing site, not adjusted for inflation.
Averages combine weighted, as the dashboard does: weighted_mean_by_landings and weighted_mean_by_catch name the weight in each rollup's note.
observedDocuments is not maintained and reads 0.
kenya_bmu_monthly and kenya_bmu_gear_monthly come from the Kenya BMU dashboard's own app database, outside the portal data dictionary.
